title: Benchmark1D2D proposed set-up
description: A set-up proposed by someone who knows a solver well: the suite applies these settings to its own model files for the base model and re-runs it. The result is shown beside the suite's own, under the proposer's name, never in its place. One file per set-up at setups/<slug>/setup.json.

base.description: The suite's model key the set-up starts from (see benchmark1d2d.setups.BASES).

title.description: A short name shown beside the result, e.g. 'tighter head tolerance'.

proposed_by.description: Person or organisation, as it should appear on the site.

github_user.description: Set by the intake bot from the account that proposed it.

tier.description: T1: exactly what the developer's own published guidance recommends (guidance_source required). T2: an expert's choice.

guidance_source.description: For T1: the developer's published guidance this set-up follows (a URL or a document and section).

developer.description: Proposed by the software's own developer.

settings.description: Setting name -> value, as the solver's input file spells it.

reason.description: Why these settings: what they fix and when an engineer would use them.
